heading: RBI Repo Rate Hike: Impact on Your Home Loan EMIs
tldr: The Reserve Bank of India recently increased the repo rate by 25 basis points to 5.50%.
This hike directly influences the interest rates on various loans, especially home loans.
Borrowers with floating-rate home loans will likely see an increase in their Equated Monthly Instalments (EMIs).
Lenders may choose to extend the loan tenure, increase the EMI amount, or a combination of both.
Reviewing your loan terms and considering prepayment options can help mitigate the impact.
caption:
Got a home loan? Listen up! The RBI recently changed a key interest rate. This might mean your monthly home loan payment (EMI) could go up. Wondering what this means for your wallet and what you can do about it? Learn more in our latest article.
